evidence: The following description covers the walkway from Kaituna Valley to The Hilltop, but other access and exit points are possible.
Te Ara Pātaka/Summit Walkway links Kaituna Valley in the Lyttelton crater to The Hilltop in the Akaroa crater.
The track can be completed as a one-way walk most of the year.
Walkers should head up to Montgomery Park Scenic Reserve and walk directly to The Hilltop.
The track emerges from the reserve onto Summit Road.

doubts: Start: the text says Kaituna Valley; I gave F6, where the Kaituna Valley Packhorse Hut Track meets Parkinsons Road, which is where the first section begins. End: 'The Hilltop' is the place T8; the walk emerges onto Summit Road, and features F4 and F5 are nearby road ends, but neither is named as the end, so I did not use them. Rod Donald Hut is reached by a side track from Waipuna Saddle, but the main way is described as going to it (section 'Port Levy saddle to Rod Donald Hut' and the return up the access track), so it is kept in via and huts. The 'Rod Donald Hut to The Hilltop via Montgomery Reserve' heading is walked as part of the way and is given the link L2 by name, although L2 is a separate walk page. The valley stream is unnamed, so it is recorded as 'valley stream' with how ford; the text says the track crosses it several times and that stepping stones can be used. Mount Herbert Shelter has a toilet and water but no bunks are mentioned, so it is not a hut. The Diamond Harbour jetty two-day public transport trip is kept as an access point because the packet does not say where its track joins. Pettigrews Road is for mountain bikes only and is recorded as an access point with that caveat. Time and distance are DOC's whole-walk values from the page header.
